title: Tariff Rules and Regulations — Sustained-Outage Credit Base Amount by Recorded Outage Cause, Electric Service Agreement
content:
**Electric Service Agreement — Tariff Rules and Regulations: base amount of the sustained-outage credit by the cause of the outage.**

1. The base amount of the sustained-outage credit is one and a half times (1.5 times) the schedule's outage credit base amount when the record's cause is equipment failure or vegetation.
2. The base amount is one and a quarter times (1.25 times) the schedule's outage credit base amount when the record's cause is animal contact or a vehicle accident.
3. For a record of any other cause, no such increase applies.
4. The cause read is the recorded cause of the outage record for which the credit is posted.
5. The base amount so set is the amount to which the increment amounts are added before that sum is limited to the cap. It is not rounded on its own; only the final credit is rounded to the cent.

**Schedule of multiples.**

| Recorded cause of the outage record | Base amount |
|---|---|
| Equipment failure | 1.5 times the schedule's outage credit base amount |
| Vegetation | 1.5 times the schedule's outage credit base amount |
| Animal contact | 1.25 times the schedule's outage credit base amount |
| Vehicle accident | 1.25 times the schedule's outage credit base amount |
| Any other cause | no increase applies |

**Hypothetical figures.** On a schedule outage credit base amount of $40.00, a record caused by equipment failure or vegetation carries a base amount of $60.00, and one caused by animal contact or a vehicle accident a base amount of $50.00. On a hypothetical base amount of $35.00, the 1.25 multiple gives $43.75 and the 1.5 multiple gives $52.50.
